jobs.name: A · 紫霄玄袖
jobs.summary: 银发道冠 · 大扇袖 · 神秘自信
jobs.detail: Closest to user inspiration but unmistakably Chinese. Mysterious confident woman, short oval face with one lifted wedge eyebrow, half-open almond eyes, subtle sly smile; silver-white long hair in TWO broad flowing masses, simple three-panel short fringe. A dark-purple Chinese cloud-shaped DAO CROWN with two smooth upward curved ornamental fins, fitted on a small tied crown section; fins are clearly a crown, not growing horns. Violet/ink-purple/ivory/muted old gold, one teal accent. FITTED high diagonal-cross-collar inner top shaped smoothly over fuller bust, dark tapered waist band, two long clean violet robe panels over dark riding leggings and simple purple boots. TWO huge rounded fan-shaped trumpet sleeves inspired by reference, each one uninterrupted broad shape; ONE large teal/lilac butterfly-like CLOUD motif spanning only the outward sleeve, no intricate butterfly scales or stars. Two broad trailing ribbons not many hairlike strips. POSE gently open arms at unequal heights, one hand lifted holding exactly TWO separated pale yellow talisman papers with a few cinnabar abstract brush marks, other hand lowered sideways holding a purple-jade handled white fly whisk; whisk handle and single grouped white tail physically connected. A slow flowing S-line, both feet apart with one knee relaxed, grounded not flying. Silhouette wide soft arcs and fluttering sleeve wings; all ornaments greatly simplified.

jobs.name: B · 丹霞镇符
jobs.summary: 短髻露额 · 斜襟短装 · 果断英气
jobs.detail: A decisive energetic protective Taoist, distinct broad squared-oval face, thick short flat brows, open focused graphic eyes, a tiny closed confident grin, no makeup. Dark black SHORT hair swept firmly off forehead into ONE very small upright clipped dao topknot with plain wooden pin, close side hair and exposed near ear, no large ponytail/flowing silver hair. CINNABAR red/ivory/charcoal with muted bronze. Costume is a SHORT practical asymmetric wrap jacket, wide ivory diagonal lapel supporting fuller feminine bust, broad dark waist cinch, ONE broad hanging sleeve at rear side and opposite fitted short sleeve/bracer, two short angular hip tabs over charcoal tapered trousers, cream shin wraps and simple red-brown low boots. Big angular lightning-like cinnabar brush motif only on one sleeve edge, not repeated glyphs everywhere. Distinct strong TRIANGULAR/diagonal silhouette. POSE shallow forward step/lunge facing left, forward hand extends two fingers together in a clear spell gesture, other hand low behind/side holds ONE short peach-wood ritual sword diagonally down with complete wooden blade and small cloud-shaped guard, one talisman paper fastened to hilt and one short red cord away from fingers. No metal sword, no staff, no fan. Mature feminine form powerful but not muscular; sleeves/tabs sweep slightly right with action. Ritual sword has bold warm wood planes, two clear joints, not tiny carvings.

jobs.name: C · 青岚灵葫
jobs.summary: 偏侧低髻 · 圆袖短摆 · 俏皮灵巧
jobs.detail: An ADULT playful clever charm-keeper Taoist, round short face with soft blunt chin, curved asymmetrical brows, one eye slightly squinted with a bright toothy asymmetric smile, short small nose; not baby or doll anatomy. CHESTNUT hair with a side-parted short curved forelock and ONE low OFFSET SIDE COIL BUN at the back, a simple pale-jade crescent clip and two short apricot fabric ends, no double buns, high ponytail or long straight hair. Pale JADE/cream/apricot bronze palette. Carefully fitted short jade cross-collar blouse with rounded cream facing enclosing fuller bust, little rounded puff sleeves, one small round cloud shoulder layer, narrow apricot fabric waistband, two rounded petal short panels over roomy jade-gray knee-length trousers, cream ankle wraps and soft green flat shoes. Graphic rhythm circles and buoyant curved short hems, ONE large quiet cream cloud motif. POSE lively slight hip turn and a small side step with one knee flexed and both feet distinct; one hand raises a SINGLE small bronze ritual bell near shoulder (finger grip correct, bell simple round outline), other hand carries a SMALL round gourd ritual vessel by its short strap beside hip; gourd has ONE yellow talisman seal with cinnabar abstract marks and no leaf/medicine symbol. No big medicine basket, no bow, no sword. Tiny talisman pouch only one. Cheerful adult curves, light tailoring not huge robe or generic sorceress. Bell and sealed gourd match the round personality and palette.

jobs.name: D · 月衡观星
jobs.summary: 乌发长簪 · 直襟窄袖 · 沉静理性
jobs.detail: A composed thoughtful divination Taoist, mature slightly LONG rounded face with blunt chin, low straight brows, narrow relaxed half-lidded simple eyes and a barely visible wry smile; subtly different eyes from A's sly look, no heavy lashes. INK BLACK straight collarbone-length hair with crisp horizontal fringe and a long horizontal JADE PIN through a neat low folded back section; a small flat moon-jade dao cap, no high crest/horns, braid or ponytail. MOON WHITE/deep blue-gray/jade and a trace of old gold. Clean vertical Chinese high diagonal-collar fitted jacket over fuller adult bust, narrow jade sash and two long STRAIGHT open outer robe lapels forming broad rectangular ivory planes, one fitted long sleeve and one quiet draped sleeve at forearm; charcoal trousers and plain slate-blue boots, both feet read. ONLY one large sparse blue cloud/star-compass abstract motif on lower hem, no many little constellations. Silhouette vertical rectangles and one round disc, restrained cloth motion. POSE calm upright contrapposto, one arm bent before waist holding a SMALL horizontal bronze Taoist LUOPAN compass disc with a central yin-yang and eight simple broad radial sectors (graphic diagram, no tiny text), the other hand extending a plain jade measuring pointer toward left at chest height. Disc sits stably on supporting palm, pointer held between natural fingers, no floating instruments or unnecessary staff. Not holding a fan or book. Strong quiet scholarly identity, no big cape wings.
